facts.text: Andrew expresses that capturing special moments and sharing the feeling of tranquility with others is satisfying.

evidence.quote: I try to capture those special moments and share that feeling with others.
It brings me joy to spread that feeling and motivate people to find their own peace.

facts.text: Audrey acknowledges that spreading peaceful feelings to others is a great way to bring happiness and motivation.

evidence.quote: Spreading that peaceful feeling to others is such a great way to bring happiness and motivation.
It brings me joy to spread that feeling and motivate people to find their own peace.

facts.text: Andrew describes nature as therapeutic and mentions the feeling of being surrounded by greenery or standing on top of a mountain as peaceful and invigorating.

evidence.quote: Nature is so therapeutic for me. It's hard to put into words how great it feels to be surrounded by greenery or standing on top of a mountain breathing in the fresh air. So peaceful and invigorating.

facts.text: Audrey states that both the person receiving and the person spreading peaceful feelings will feel great.

evidence.quote: Not only the receiving end feels great, the person spreading it will feel great as well!
